claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Procaterol is a beta2-adrenergic receptor agonist that at 2.5 uM is expected to be largely inactive as a cytotoxic agent, since beta2 agonism does not directly kill cancer cells and no off-target cytotoxic liability is evident at this concentration.
